text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Kobe Shimbun Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин considers all the
training she's
done up to this point and
imagines how the race
will develop.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She declares that she'll secure victory,
then heads
for the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
